title: Core domain schema, event store and Alembic migrations

acceptance_gates.description: Core domain tables are created from recovered or ADR-approved v1.2 DDL, with RLS policies on every tenant-scoped table.
The event store is append-only for application roles and the previous_hash/event_hash chain detects tampering.
Fresh-database and previous-release migrations both succeed under the expand/migrate/contract sequence.

rollback: Revert the migration commits and restore the prior schema revision; no domain DDL may be presented as recovered v1.2 source text while SRC-001 is open.
